note: Written by tools/audio/gen-sfx.py. approved is false until Tjitse has listened (sfx.sh --approve id); the game plays only approved files.

egg-crack.text: A small magical egg cracking open: three gentle shell cracks, then a soft sparkly chime. Cartoon, for a children's game. No voice, no music.

nicker-1.text: A tiny baby pony giving a short, happy, gentle nicker. Cute and soft, close up. No music.

nicker-2.text: A baby horse's soft, happy little whinny, very short and high. Cute, close up. No music.

stable-door.text: A small wooden stable half door swinging open with a soft creak and a gentle wooden knock. No voice.

trunk-lid.text: An old wooden toy chest lid creaking open, then a short magical sparkle shimmer. Warm and gentle. No voice.

gift-paper.text: Soft crinkle of tissue paper as a small present is unwrapped. Gentle, close up. No voice.

dress-swish.text: A soft swish of a silky princess dress as it twirls. Gentle fabric whoosh, close up.

bead-clink.text: A single small glass bead clicking onto a string: one tiny bright clink.

crown-twinkle.text: A magical twinkle of tiny bells and a soft shimmer, like a crown sparkling. Gentle, for a children's game.

hay-rustle.text: Dry hay bundles dropped into a wooden rack: a soft rustle, close up. No animals.

splash-1.text: A cheerful big splash as a child slides into a pond: water spray and a few droplets. No voice, no screaming.

splash-2.text: A playful splash into a garden pond: a bright water splash with bubbly droplets. No voice.

slide-whoosh.text: A smooth playful whoosh of sliding down a plastic slide, quick and bright. No voice.

bedtime-bell.text: A soft evening bell ringing twice in the distance. Warm and calm, bedtime.

owl.text: A soft friendly owl hooting twice at night, gentle and far away. Calm.

heart-glow.text: A warm gentle magical shimmer rising up, like a heart starting to glow. Soft and sweet, for a children's game.

amb-day.text: A calm sunny meadow: soft birdsong far away and a light breeze in the grass. Peaceful. No voices, no music, no sudden sounds.
